directAnswerBlocks.question: What is lead generation automation for real estate?
directAnswerBlocks.shortAnswer: Lead generation automation uses AI tools to capture, qualify, and follow up with potential buyers and sellers automatically — so real estate agents spend less time chasing cold leads and more time closing deals.

directAnswerBlocks.question: How do real estate agents automate lead generation?
directAnswerBlocks.shortAnswer: Real estate agents automate lead generation by connecting an AI system that captures inquiries from their website and other channels, scores them, and triggers follow-up messages without manual input.
